### What operating system did you use?

ubuntu 22

### What installation method did you use?

Deb/Apt

On prem/Self-hosted

root@participant1:~# pg_upgradecluster 15 main

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
@reporter Thanks for raising the issue.

The error is normally printed if you haven't set the variable `timescaledb.restoring` to `on`, which will disable extension-specific hooks.

If you look into the instructions for [Migrate from TimescaleDB using pg_dump/restore](https://<redacted-host>/migrate/latest/pg-dump-and-restore/pg-dump-restore-from-timescaledb/#migrate-from-timescaledb-using-pg_dumprestore) you can see that `timescaledb_pre_restore` is called, which will disable the hooks.

Did you do that prior to doing a restore? I do not think that `pg_ugradecluster` does that automatically since it is a PostgreSQL tool.
